name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Character Breakfast: Mickey Waffles, Scrambled Eggs & Banana
brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn "Minnie & Friends" Breakfast (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
searchKeywords: minnie and friends breakfast plaza inn
whyItWorks: The buffet lets you build a clean plate of fluffy scrambled eggs, made-to-order egg-white or ham/cheddar omelets, classic Mickey-shaped waffles, and ripe bananas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Load your plate with scrambled eggs or a plain cheese omelet, Mickey waffles, turkey sausage/bacon, and a banana; ask the server for allergy-friendly/dairy-free Mickey waffles if lactose-sensitive.
watchOuts: Disney can make dairy-free/gluten-free Mickey waffles on request at any table-service or buffet breakfast!
